draft.finding: Status marks were too small, especially alongside Gusher blood/arms. Draft images retained.

final.finding: Larger and higher cyan fear strokes and purple confusion dots are distinct above all five bodies. Gusher blood remains a separate red column. Horf retains its bone palette and uses overhead cues. Body silhouettes, ground contact/shadows and Original scene treatment remain intact.

limits: These are isolated open-floor captures; crowded-room and scenery-occlusion acceptance remain open.
